#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Materialize vault assembly snippets into runnable ARM64 C sources."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Optional

from sdc_vault import SDCVault


REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "artifacts" / "materialized"


def _escape_c_string(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


def _asm_block(lines: Iterable[str]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'"{_escape_c_string(line)}\\n"' for line in lines if line.strip())


def render_materialized_source(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str) -> str:
    asm_lines = [line.rstrip() for line in asm_content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not asm_lines:
        asm_lines = ["nop"]

    benchmark_body = [
        ".text",
        ".align 4",
        ".global sdc_benchmark_body",
        ".type sdc_benchmark_body, %function",
        "sdc_benchmark_body:",
        "adr x16, sdc_gprs",
        "mov x0, #0",
        "mov x1, #0",
        "mov x2, #0",
        "mov x3, #0",
        "mov x4, #0",
        "mov x5, #0",
        "mov x6, #0",
        "mov x7, #0",
        "movi v0.16b, #0",
        "movi v1.16b, #0",
        "movi v2.16b, #0",
        "movi v3.16b, #0",
        "movi v4.16b, #0",
        "movi v5.16b, #0",
        "movi v6.16b, #0",
        "movi v7.16b, #0",
    ]
    benchmark_body.extend(asm_lines)
    benchmark_body.extend(
        [
            "adr x16, sdc_gprs",
            "str x0, [x16, #0]",
            "str x1, [x16, #8]",
            "str x2, [x16, #16]",
            "str x3, [x16, #24]",
            "str x4, [x16, #32]",
            "str x5, [x16, #40]",
            "str x6, [x16, #48]",
            "str x7, [x16, #56]",
            "str x8, [x16, #64]",
            "str x9, [x16, #72]",
            "str x10, [x16, #80]",
            "str x11, [x16, #88]",
            "str x12, [x16, #96]",
            "str x13, [x16, #104]",
            "str x14, [x16, #112]",
            "str x15, [x16, #120]",
            "str x16, [x16, #128]",
            "str x17, [x16, #136]",
            "str x18, [x16, #144]",
            "str x19, [x16, #152]",
            "str x20, [x16, #160]",
            "str x21, [x16, #168]",
            "str x22, [x16, #176]",
            "str x23, [x16, #184]",
            "str x24, [x16, #192]",
            "str x25, [x16, #200]",
            "str x26, [x16, #208]",
            "str x27, [x16, #216]",
            "str x28, [x16, #224]",
            "str x29, [x16, #232]",
            "str x30, [x16, #240]",
            "adr x16, sdc_nzcv",
            "mrs x17, nzcv",
            "str x17, [x16]",
            "adr x16, sdc_simd",
            "str q0, [x16, #0]",
            "str q1, [x16, #16]",
            "str q2, [x16, #32]",
            "str q3, [x16, #48]",
            "str q4, [x16, #64]",
            "str q5, [x16, #80]",
            "str q6, [x16, #96]",
            "str q7, [x16, #112]",
            "ret",
            ".size sdc_benchmark_body, .-sdc_benchmark_body",
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(
        [
            "#include <inttypes.h>",
            "#include <stdint.h>",
            "#include <stdio.h>",
            "#include <stdlib.h>",
            "",
            f"/* Materialized from vault testcase: {testcase_key} */",
            "static uint64_t sdc_gprs[31] = {0};",
            "static uint64_t sdc_nzcv = 0;",
            "static uint8_t sdc_simd[8 * 16] = {0};",
            "static uint8_t sdc_memory[256] = {0};",
            "",
            "static inline uint64_t sdc_rotl64(uint64_t value, unsigned shift)",
            "{",
            "    return (value << shift) | (value >> (64 - shift));",
            "}",
            "",
            "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_u64(uint64_t state, uint64_t value)",
            "{",
            "    state ^= value + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (state << 6) + (state >> 2);",
            "    return sdc_rotl64(state, 17);",
            "}",
            "",
            "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_bytes(",
            "    uint64_t state, const uint8_t *buffer, size_t size)",
            "{",
            "    for (size_t index = 0; index < size; ++index)",
            "    {",
            "        state ^= (uint64_t)buffer[index] << ((index & 7U) * 8U);",
            "        state *= 0x100000001b3ULL;",
            "        state = sdc_rotl64(state, 9);",
            "    }",
            "    return state;",
            "}",
            "",
            "extern void sdc_benchmark_body(void);",
            "__asm__(",
            _asm_block(benchmark_body),
            ");",
            "",
            "int main(void)",
            "{",
            "    uint64_t sdc_digest = 0xcbf29ce484222325ULL;",
            "    sdc_benchmark_body();",
            "    for (size_t sdc_index = 0; sdc_index < 31; ++sdc_index)",
            "    {",
            "        sdc_digest = sdc_mix_u64(sdc_digest, sdc_gprs[sdc_index]);",
            "    }",
            "    sdc_digest = sdc_mix_u64(sdc_digest, sdc_nzcv);",
            "    sdc_digest = sdc_mix_bytes(sdc_digest, sdc_simd, sizeof(sdc_simd));",
            "    sdc_digest = sdc_mix_bytes(sdc_digest, sdc_memory, sizeof(sdc_memory));",
            '    printf("SDC_DIGEST=%016" PRIx64 "\\n", sdc_digest);',
            "    fflush(stdout);",
            "    return 0;",
            "}",
            "",
        ]
    )


def _decode_metadata(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    raw_value = row["metadata_json"] if "metadata_json" in row.keys() else "{}"
    if isinstance(raw_value, dict):
        return dict(raw_value)
    if raw_value in (None, ""):
        return {}
    return json.loads(str(raw_value))


def materialize_testcase(
    vault: SDCVault,
    testcase_key: str,
    *,
    output_root: Path = DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT,
) -> Path:
    row = vault.get_testcase(testcase_key)
    if row is None:
        raise KeyError(f"Unknown testcase_key: {testcase_key}")

    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source_path = (output_root / f"{testcase_key}.c").resolve()
    source_path.write_text(
        render_materialized_source(str(row["asm_content"]), testcase_key),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    metadata = _decode_metadata(row)
    metadata["source_path"] = str(source_path)
    metadata["materialized"] = {
        "source_path": str(source_path),
        "output_root": str(output_root.resolve()),
    }
    vault.update_execution_result(testcase_key, metadata=metadata)
    return source_path


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Materialize vault assembly entries into ARM64 C sources."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--db", type=Path, required=True, help="Vault database path.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--testcase-key",
        action="append",
        default=[],
        help="Specific testcase key to materialize. Repeat as needed.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--limit",
        type=int,
        default=0,
        help="If no testcase key is provided, materialize up to this many pending entries.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-root",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT,
        help="Directory for generated C files.",
    )
    return parser


def main() -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    with SDCVault(args.db) as vault:
        testcase_keys = list(args.testcase_key)
        if not testcase_keys:
            pending = vault.fetch_top_k_risky(args.limit or 10)
            testcase_keys = [str(row["testcase_key"]) for row in pending]

        materialized = [
            str(materialize_testcase(vault, testcase_key, output_root=args.output_root))
            for testcase_key in testcase_keys
        ]

    payload = {
        "count": len(materialized),
        "sources": materialized,
    }
    print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SQLite-backed testcase vault for ARM64 SDC fuzzing."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Sequence


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _json_dumps(value: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value or {}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)


@dataclass
class VaultEntry:
    testcase_key: str
    asm_content: str
    target_name: str
    policy_name: str = "sdc_fuzzing"
    ace_score: float = 0.0
    ibr_score: float = 0.0
    memory_pressure_score: float = 0.0
    risk_score: float = 0.0
    qemu_golden_hash: Optional[str] = None
    gem5_fault_hash: Optional[str] = None
    mcpat_power: Optional[float] = None
    status: str = "PENDING"
    metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

    def to_record(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        record = asdict(self)
        record["metadata_json"] = _json_dumps(record.pop("metadata"))
        return record


class SDCVault:
    """Persistent testcase storage for the offline/online SDC loop."""

    DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1

    def __init__(self, db_path: Path | str):
        self._db_path = Path(db_path)
        self._db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(str(self._db_path))
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._initialize()

    @property
    def path(self) -> Path:
        return self._db_path

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._conn.close()

    def _initialize(self) -> None:
        with self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vault_meta (
                    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    value TEXT NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offline_testcases (
                    test_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    testcase_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    target_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    policy_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    asm_content TEXT NOT NULL,
                    ace_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                    ibr_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                    memory_pressure_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                    risk_score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
                    qemu_golden_hash TEXT,
                    gem5_fault_hash TEXT,
                    mcpat_power REAL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
                    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_offline_testcases_status_risk
                ON offline_testcases(status, risk_score DESC, ace_score DESC, ibr_score DESC)
                """
            )
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO vault_meta(key, value)
                VALUES ('schema_version', ?)
                """,
                (str(self.DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION),),
            )

    def upsert_testcase(self, entry: VaultEntry) -> int:
        now = _utcnow()
        record = entry.to_record()
        with self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO offline_testcases (
                    testcase_key,
                    target_name,
                    policy_name,
                    asm_content,
                    ace_score,
                    ibr_score,
                    memory_pressure_score,
                    risk_score,
                    qemu_golden_hash,
                    gem5_fault_hash,
                    mcpat_power,
                    status,
                    metadata_json,
                    created_at,
                    updated_at
                ) VALUES (
                    :testcase_key,
                    :target_name,
                    :policy_name,
                    :asm_content,
                    :ace_score,
                    :ibr_score,
                    :memory_pressure_score,
                    :risk_score,
                    :qemu_golden_hash,
                    :gem5_fault_hash,
                    :mcpat_power,
                    :status,
                    :metadata_json,
                    :created_at,
                    :updated_at
                )
                ON CONFLICT(testcase_key) DO UPDATE SET
                    target_name=excluded.target_name,
                    policy_name=excluded.policy_name,
                    asm_content=excluded.asm_content,
                    ace_score=excluded.ace_score,
                    ibr_score=excluded.ibr_score,
                    memory_pressure_score=excluded.memory_pressure_score,
                    risk_score=excluded.risk_score,
                    qemu_golden_hash=COALESCE(excluded.qemu_golden_hash, offline_testcases.qemu_golden_hash),
                    gem5_fault_hash=COALESCE(excluded.gem5_fault_hash, offline_testcases.gem5_fault_hash),
                    mcpat_power=COALESCE(excluded.mcpat_power, offline_testcases.mcpat_power),
                    status=excluded.status,
                    metadata_json=excluded.metadata_json,
                    updated_at=excluded.updated_at
                """,
                {
                    **record,
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now,
                },
            )
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT test_id FROM offline_testcases WHERE testcase_key = ?",
                (entry.testcase_key,),
            ).fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        return int(row["test_id"])

    def update_execution_result(
        self,
        testcase_key: str,
        *,
        qemu_golden_hash: Optional[str] = None,
        gem5_fault_hash: Optional[str] = None,
        mcpat_power: Optional[float] = None,
        status: Optional[str] = None,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        assignments: List[str] = ["updated_at = :updated_at"]
        params: Dict[str, Any] = {"testcase_key": testcase_key, "updated_at": _utcnow()}

        if qemu_golden_hash is not None:
            assignments.append("qemu_golden_hash = :qemu_golden_hash")
            params["qemu_golden_hash"] = qemu_golden_hash
        if gem5_fault_hash is not None:
            assignments.append("gem5_fault_hash = :gem5_fault_hash")
            params["gem5_fault_hash"] = gem5_fault_hash
        if mcpat_power is not None:
            assignments.append("mcpat_power = :mcpat_power")
            params["mcpat_power"] = mcpat_power
        if status is not None:
            assignments.append("status = :status")
            params["status"] = status
        if metadata is not None:
            assignments.append("metadata_json = :metadata_json")
            params["metadata_json"] = _json_dumps(metadata)

        with self._conn:
            self._conn.execute(
                f"""
                UPDATE offline_testcases
                SET {", ".join(assignments)}
                WHERE testcase_key = :testcase_key
                """,
                params,
            )

    def mark_status(self, testcase_key: str, status: str) -> None:
        self.update_execution_result(testcase_key, status=status)

    def fetch_top_k_risky(
        self,
        limit: int,
        statuses: Sequence[str] = ("PENDING",),
    ) -> List[sqlite3.Row]:
        placeholders = ", ".join("?" for _ in statuses)
        query = f"""
            SELECT *
            FROM offline_testcases
            WHERE status IN ({placeholders})
            ORDER BY
                risk_score DESC,
                (ace_score * 0.6 + ibr_score * 0.4) DESC,
                memory_pressure_score DESC,
                test_id ASC
            LIMIT ?
        """
        cursor = self._conn.execute(query, [*statuses, limit])
        return cursor.fetchall()

    def list_testcases(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 50,
        status: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[sqlite3.Row]:
        if status is None:
            cursor = self._conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT *
                FROM offline_testcases
                ORDER BY test_id DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """,
                (limit,),
            )
        else:
            cursor = self._conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT *
                FROM offline_testcases
                WHERE status = ?
                ORDER BY test_id DESC
                LIMIT ?
                """,
                (status, limit),
            )
        return cursor.fetchall()

    def get_testcase(self, testcase_key: str) -> Optional[sqlite3.Row]:
        return self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM offline_testcases WHERE testcase_key = ?",
            (testcase_key,),
        ).fetchone()

    def count(self, *, status: Optional[str] = None) -> int:
        if status is None:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM offline_testcases"
            ).fetchone()
        else:
            row = self._conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM offline_testcases WHERE status = ?",
                (status,),
            ).fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        return int(row["count"])

    def __enter__(self) -> "SDCVault":
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
        self.close()

                    mcpat_error=mcpat_error,
                    status=status,
                ))
                print(f"  → {status}")

                    gem5_out_dir="",
                    gem5_stats={},

def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Power-analysis pipeline: vault → compile → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault"
    )
    p.add_argument("--db", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_VAULT, help="Vault SQLite path")
    p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10, help="Number of PENDING testcases to process")
    p.add_argument("--gem5-binary", type=Path, REDACTED)
    p.add_argument("--gem5-config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG)
    p.add_argument("--mcpat-binary", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY)
    p.add_argument("--gcc", default=None, help="aarch64-elf-gcc path (default: search PATH)")
    p.add_argument("--materialized-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT)
    return p


def main() -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    results = run_power_analysis(
        vault_path=args.db,
        limit=args.limit,
        gem5_binary=args.gem5_binary,
        gem5_config=args.gem5_config,
        mcpat_binary=args.mcpat_binary,
        gcc=args.gcc,
        materialized_root=args.materialized_root,
    )
    completed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status in ("COMPLETED", "GEM5_OK"))
    failed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "FAILED")
    print(f"\nDone: {completed} completed, {failed} failed.")
    return 0

    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

]

    for path in _AARCH64_GCC_CANDIDATES:
        if shutil.isfile(path) or shutil.which(path):

    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


def _asm_block(lines) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'"{_escape_c_string(line)}\\n"' for line in lines if line.strip())


# Inline version of render_materialized_source (avoids import of sdc_materialize
# to keep the file self-contained and avoid path issues).
def render_materialized_source(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str) -> str:
    asm_lines = [line.rstrip() for line in asm_content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not asm_lines:
        asm_lines = ["nop"]

    benchmark_body = [
        ".text", ".align 4",
        ".global sdc_benchmark_body", ".type sdc_benchmark_body, %function",
        "sdc_benchmark_body:",
        "adr x16, sdc_gprs",

    # Clear all GPRs
    for r in range(31):

    # Clear SIMD

        benchmark_body.append(f"movi v{v}.16b, #0")
    benchmark_body.extend(asm_lines)

        benchmark_body.append(f"str x{i}, [x16, #{i * 8}]")
    benchmark_body.extend([
        "adr x16, sdc_nzcv", "mrs x17, nzcv", "str x17, [x16]",
        "adr x16, sdc_simd",
    ])
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str q{v}, [x16, #{v * 16}]")
    benchmark_body.append("ret")

        "#include <stdint.h>",

        f"/* Materialized: {testcase_key} */",
        "static uint64_t sdc_gprs[31] = {0};",
        "static uint64_t sdc_nzcv = 0;",
        "static uint8_t sdc_simd[8 * 16] = {0};",
        "static uint8_t sdc_memory[256] = {0};",
        "",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_rotl64(uint64_t v, unsigned s){",
        "    return (v << s) | (v >> (64 - s));",

        "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_u64(uint64_t s, uint64_t v){",
        "    s ^= v + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (s << 6) + (s >> 2);",

        "    d = sdc_mix_bytes(d, sdc_simd, sizeof(sdc_simd));",

    """Write C source and compile to static ELF. Returns path to ELF."""
    source = render_materialized_source(asm_content, testcase_key)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sdc_mat_") as tmp:
        tmp_path = Path(tmp)
        src_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.c"
        elf_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        src_path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
        compile_cmd = [
            gcc,
            "-static",
            "-march=armv8-a",
            "-nostdlib",
            "-o", str(elf_path),
            str(src_path),
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(compile_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Compilation failed for {testcase_key}:\n{result.stderr}"
            )
        # Copy ELF to materialized root
        out_dir = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT / testcase_key

    """Run gem5 SE on the ELF. Returns gem5 stats dict."""
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [
        str(gem5_binary),
        "--outdir", str(out_dir),
        "-r", "0",
        str(gem5_config),
        "--elf", str(elf_path),
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = {"returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}

    stats_file = out_dir / "stats.txt"
    config_file = out_dir / "config.json"
    if stats_file.exists():
        stats["stats_file"] = str(stats_file)
        # Parse a few key stats
        for line in stats_file.read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.startswith("sim_ticks"):
                continue
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    stats["sim_ticks"] = int(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass

    if config_file.exists():
        stats["config_file"] = str(config_file)

    return stats


def _run_mcpat(target_dir: Path, mcpat_binary: Optional[Path]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run McPAT on gem5 output directory."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "mcpat"))
    from pypat.conversion.convert import run as run_mcpat_conversion
    result = run_mcpat_conversion(
        target_dir,
        template_profile="arm64-kunpeng920",
        print_level=1,
        mcpat_binary=mcpat_binary,
    )
    return {
        "power_total": float(result.get("power_total", 0.0)),
        "power_dynamic": float(result.get("power_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "power_leakage": float(result.get("power_leakage", 0.0)),
        "power_peak_dynamic": float(result.get("power_peak_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "mcpat_input": str(result.get("mcpat_input", "")),
        "mcpat_output": str(result.get("mcpat_output", "")),
        "stats_file": str(result.get("stats_file", "")),
        "config_file": str(result.get("config_file", "")),
    }


def _hash_key(asm_lines: List[str]) -> str:
    content = "\n".join(asm_lines)
    return hashlib.sha1(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class PowerAnalysisResult:
    testcase_key: str
    elf_path: str
    gem5_out_dir: str
    gem5_stats: Dict[str, Any]
    mcpat_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    mcpat_error: Optional[str]

    vault_path: Path,

    mcpat_binary: Optional[Path] = None,

        "    d = sdc_mix_u64(d, sdc_nzcv);",
        "    d = sdc_mix_bytes(d, sdc_simd, sizeof(sdc_simd));",
        '    printf("SDC_DIGEST=%016" PRIx64 "\\n", d);',
        "    fflush(stdout);",
        "    return 0;",
        "}",
    ])


def _write_c_and_compile(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str, gcc: str) -> Path:
    """Write C source and compile to static ELF. Returns path to ELF."""
    source = render_materialized_source(asm_content, testcase_key)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sdc_mat_") as tmp:
        tmp_path = Path(tmp)
        src_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.c"
        elf_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        src_path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
        compile_cmd = [
            gcc,
            "-static",
            "-march=armv8-a",
            "-nostdlib",
            "-o", str(elf_path),
            str(src_path),
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(compile_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Compilation failed for {testcase_key}:\n{result.stderr}"
            )
        # Copy ELF to materialized root
        out_dir = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT / testcase_key
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_elf = out_dir / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        shutil.copy2(elf_path, dest_elf)
        return dest_elf


def _run_gem5(elf_path: Path, gem5_binary: Path, gem5_config: Path, out_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run gem5 SE on the ELF. Returns gem5 stats dict."""
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [
        str(gem5_binary),
        "--outdir", str(out_dir),
        "-r", "0",
        str(gem5_config),
        "--elf", str(elf_path),
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = {"returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}

    stats_file = out_dir / "stats.txt"
    config_file = out_dir / "config.json"
    if stats_file.exists():
        stats["stats_file"] = str(stats_file)
        # Parse a few key stats
        for line in stats_file.read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.startswith("sim_ticks"):
                continue
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    stats["sim_ticks"] = int(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass

    if config_file.exists():
        stats["config_file"] = str(config_file)

    return stats


def _run_mcpat(target_dir: Path, mcpat_binary: Optional[Path]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run McPAT on gem5 output directory."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "mcpat"))
    from pypat.conversion.convert import run as run_mcpat_conversion
    result = run_mcpat_conversion(
        target_dir,
        template_profile="arm64-kunpeng920",
        print_level=1,
        mcpat_binary=mcpat_binary,
    )
    return {
        "power_total": float(result.get("power_total", 0.0)),
        "power_dynamic": float(result.get("power_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "power_leakage": float(result.get("power_leakage", 0.0)),
        "power_peak_dynamic": float(result.get("power_peak_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "mcpat_input": str(result.get("mcpat_input", "")),
        "mcpat_output": str(result.get("mcpat_output", "")),
        "stats_file": str(result.get("stats_file", "")),
        "config_file": str(result.get("config_file", "")),
    }


def _hash_key(asm_lines: List[str]) -> str:
    content = "\n".join(asm_lines)
    return hashlib.sha1(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class PowerAnalysisResult:
    testcase_key: str
    elf_path: str
    gem5_out_dir: str
    gem5_stats: Dict[str, Any]
    mcpat_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    mcpat_error: Optional[str]
    status: str  # COMPLETED or FAILED


def run_power_analysis(
    vault_path: Path,
    limit: int = 10,
    gem5_binary: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_BINARY,
    gem5_config: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG,
    mcpat_binary: Optional[Path] = None,
    gcc: str = None,
    materialized_root: Path = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT,
) -> List[PowerAnalysisResult]:
    """Run the full power-analysis pipeline on top-k vault entries."""
    if gcc is None:
        gcc = _find_aarch64_gcc()

    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))
    from sdc_vault import SDCVault, VaultEntry

    with SDCVault(vault_path) as vault:
        # Fetch PENDING entries sorted by risk score
        rows = vault.fetch_top_k_risky(limit, statuses=["PENDING"])
        if not rows:
            print("No PENDING testcases in vault. Nothing to do.")
            return []

        print(f"Processing {len(rows)} testcase(s)...")
        results: List[PowerAnalysisResult] = []

        for row in rows:
            testcase_key = str(row["testcase_key"])
            asm_content = str(row["asm_content"])
            print(f"\n[{testcase_key}] ACE={row['ace_score']:.3f} RISK={row['risk_score']:.3f}")

            try:
                # 1. Compile
                print(f"  Compiling with {gcc}...")
                elf_path = _write_c_and_compile(asm_content, testcase_key, gcc)
                print(f"  ELF: {elf_path}")

                # 2. Run gem5 SE
                out_dir = materialized_root / testcase_key / "gem5_out"
                print(f"  Running gem5 SE...")
                gem5_stats = _run_gem5(elf_path, gem5_binary, gem5_config, out_dir)
                print(f"  gem5 exit={gem5_stats.get('returncode', -1)}, ticks={gem5_stats.get('sim_ticks', '?')}")

                # 3. Run McPAT
                mcpat_result = None
                mcpat_error = None
                print(f"  Running McPAT...")
                try:
                    mcpat_result = _run_mcpat(out_dir, mcpat_binary)
                    print(f"  McPAT power_total={mcpat_result['power_total']:.4f}W "
                          f"dynamic={mcpat_result['power_dynamic']:.4f}W")
                except Exception as exc:
                    mcpat_error = str(exc)
                    print(f"  McPAT error (non-fatal): {mcpat_error}")

                # 4. Update vault
                status = "COMPLETED" if mcpat_result else "GEM5_OK"
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    mcpat_power=mcpat_result["power_total"] if mcpat_result else None,
                    status=status,
                    metadata={"gem5_stats": gem5_stats, "mcpat_result": mcpat_result},
                )

                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path=str(elf_path),
                    gem5_out_dir=str(out_dir),
                    gem5_stats=gem5_stats,
                    mcpat_result=mcpat_result,
                    mcpat_error=mcpat_error,
                    status=status,
                ))
                print(f"  → {status}")

            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"  ✗ FAILED: {exc}")
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    status="FAILED",
                    metadata={"error": str(exc)},
                )
                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path="",
                    gem5_out_dir="",
                    gem5_stats={},
                    mcpat_result=None,
                    mcpat_error=str(exc),
                    status="FAILED",
                ))

        return results


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Power-analysis pipeline: vault → compile → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault"
    )
    p.add_argument("--db", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_VAULT, help="Vault SQLite path")
    p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10, help="Number of PENDING testcases to process")
    p.add_argument("--gem5-binary", type=Path, REDACTED)
    p.add_argument("--gem5-config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG)
    p.add_argument("--mcpat-binary", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY)
    p.add_argument("--gcc", default=None, help="aarch64-elf-gcc path (default: search PATH)")
    p.add_argument("--materialized-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT)
    return p


def main() -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    results = run_power_analysis(
        vault_path=args.db,
        limit=args.limit,
        gem5_binary=args.gem5_binary,
        gem5_config=args.gem5_config,
        mcpat_binary=args.mcpat_binary,
        gcc=args.gcc,
        materialized_root=args.materialized_root,
    )
    completed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status in ("COMPLETED", "GEM5_OK"))
    failed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "FAILED")
    print(f"\nDone: {completed} completed, {failed} failed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Power-analysis pipeline: vault → materialization → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

# Repo root
REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_VAULT = REPO_ROOT / "artifacts" / "sdc_vault.sqlite3"
DEFAULT_GEM5_BINARY = REPO_ROOT / "gem5" / "build" / "ARM" / "gem5.opt"
DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG = (
    REPO_ROOT / "gem5" / "configs" / "example" / "arm" / "sdc_kunpeng920_se.py"
)
DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY = REPO_ROOT / "mcpat" / "mcpat" / "mcpat"
DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "artifacts" / "materialized"
DIGEST_RE = re.compile(r"SDC_DIGEST=([0-9a-fA-F]+)")

# Path to the aarch64 bare-metal cross-compiler
_AARCH64_GCC_CANDIDATES = [
    "/opt/homebrew/bin/aarch64-elf-gcc",
    "/usr/local/bin/aarch64-elf-gcc",
    "aarch64-elf-gcc",
]


def _find_aarch64_gcc() -> str:
    for path in _AARCH64_GCC_CANDIDATES:
        if Path(path).is_file() or shutil.which(path):
            return path
    return "aarch64-elf-gcc"


def _escape_c_string(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


def _asm_block(lines) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'"{_escape_c_string(line)}\\n"' for line in lines if line.strip())


# Inline version of render_materialized_source (avoids import of sdc_materialize
# to keep the file self-contained and avoid path issues).
def render_materialized_source(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str) -> str:
    asm_lines = [line.rstrip() for line in asm_content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not asm_lines:
        asm_lines = ["nop"]

    benchmark_body = [
        ".text", ".align 4",
        ".global sdc_benchmark_body", ".type sdc_benchmark_body, %function",
        "sdc_benchmark_body:",
        "adr x16, sdc_gprs",
    ]
    # Clear all GPRs
    for r in range(31):
        benchmark_body.append(f"mov x{r}, #0")
    # Clear SIMD
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"movi v{v}.16b, #0")
    benchmark_body.extend(asm_lines)
    # Capture final state
    for i in range(31):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str x{i}, [x16, #{i * 8}]")
    benchmark_body.extend([
        "adr x16, sdc_nzcv", "mrs x17, nzcv", "str x17, [x16]",
        "adr x16, sdc_simd",
    ])
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str q{v}, [x16, #{v * 16}]")
    benchmark_body.append("ret")

    return "\n".join([
        "#include <inttypes.h>",
        "#include <stdint.h>",
        "#include <stdio.h>",
        "#include <stdlib.h>",
        f"/* Materialized: {testcase_key} */",
        "static uint64_t sdc_gprs[31] = {0};",
        "static uint64_t sdc_nzcv = 0;",
        "static uint8_t sdc_simd[8 * 16] = {0};",
        "static uint8_t sdc_memory[256] = {0};",
        "",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_rotl64(uint64_t v, unsigned s){",
        "    return (v << s) | (v >> (64 - s));",
        "}",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_u64(uint64_t s, uint64_t v){",
        "    s ^= v + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (s << 6) + (s >> 2);",
        "    return sdc_rotl64(s, 17);",
        "}",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_bytes(uint64_t s,",
        "    const uint8_t *buf, size_t n){",
        "    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i){",
        "        s ^= (uint64_t)buf[i] << ((i & 7U) * 8U);",
        "        s *= 0x100000001b3ULL;",
        "        s = sdc_rotl64(s, 9);",
        "    }",
        "    return s;",
        "}",
        "extern void sdc_benchmark_body(void);",
        "__asm__(",
        _asm_block(benchmark_body),
        ");",
        "int main(void){",
        "    uint64_t d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ULL;",
        "    sdc_benchmark_body();",
        "    for (int i = 0; i < 31; ++i) d = sdc_mix_u64(d, sdc_gprs[i]);",
        "    d = sdc_mix_u64(d, sdc_nzcv);",
        "    d = sdc_mix_bytes(d, sdc_simd, sizeof(sdc_simd));",
        '    printf("SDC_DIGEST=%016" PRIx64 "\\n", d);',
        "    fflush(stdout);",
        "    return 0;",
        "}",
    ])


def _write_c_and_compile(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str, gcc: str) -> Path:
    """Write C source and compile to static ELF. Returns path to ELF."""
    source = render_materialized_source(asm_content, testcase_key)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sdc_mat_") as tmp:
        tmp_path = Path(tmp)
        src_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.c"
        elf_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        src_path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
        compile_cmd = [
            gcc,
            "-static",
            "-march=armv8-a",
            "-nostdlib",
            "-o", str(elf_path),
            str(src_path),
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(compile_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Compilation failed for {testcase_key}:\n{result.stderr}"
            )
        # Copy ELF to materialized root
        out_dir = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT / testcase_key
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_elf = out_dir / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        shutil.copy2(elf_path, dest_elf)
        return dest_elf


def _run_gem5(elf_path: Path, gem5_binary: Path, gem5_config: Path, out_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run gem5 SE on the ELF. Returns gem5 stats dict."""
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [
        str(gem5_binary),
        "--outdir", str(out_dir),
        "-r", "0",
        str(gem5_config),
        "--elf", str(elf_path),
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = {"returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}

    stats_file = out_dir / "stats.txt"
    config_file = out_dir / "config.json"
    if stats_file.exists():
        stats["stats_file"] = str(stats_file)
        # Parse a few key stats
        for line in stats_file.read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.startswith("sim_ticks"):
                continue
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    stats["sim_ticks"] = int(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass

    if config_file.exists():
        stats["config_file"] = str(config_file)

    return stats


def _run_mcpat(target_dir: Path, mcpat_binary: Optional[Path]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run McPAT on gem5 output directory."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "mcpat"))
    from pypat.conversion.convert import run as run_mcpat_conversion
    result = run_mcpat_conversion(
        target_dir,
        template_profile="arm64-kunpeng920",
        print_level=1,
        mcpat_binary=mcpat_binary,
    )
    return {
        "power_total": float(result.get("power_total", 0.0)),
        "power_dynamic": float(result.get("power_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "power_leakage": float(result.get("power_leakage", 0.0)),
        "power_peak_dynamic": float(result.get("power_peak_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "mcpat_input": str(result.get("mcpat_input", "")),
        "mcpat_output": str(result.get("mcpat_output", "")),
        "stats_file": str(result.get("stats_file", "")),
        "config_file": str(result.get("config_file", "")),
    }


def _hash_key(asm_lines: List[str]) -> str:
    content = "\n".join(asm_lines)
    return hashlib.sha1(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class PowerAnalysisResult:
    testcase_key: str
    elf_path: str
    gem5_out_dir: str
    gem5_stats: Dict[str, Any]
    mcpat_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    mcpat_error: Optional[str]
    status: str  # COMPLETED or FAILED


def run_power_analysis(
    vault_path: Path,
    limit: int = 10,
    gem5_binary: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_BINARY,
    gem5_config: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG,
    mcpat_binary: Optional[Path] = None,
    gcc: str = None,
    materialized_root: Path = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT,
) -> List[PowerAnalysisResult]:
    """Run the full power-analysis pipeline on top-k vault entries."""
    if gcc is None:
        gcc = _find_aarch64_gcc()

    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))
    from sdc_vault import SDCVault, VaultEntry

    with SDCVault(vault_path) as vault:
        # Fetch PENDING entries sorted by risk score
        rows = vault.fetch_top_k_risky(limit, statuses=["PENDING"])
        if not rows:
            print("No PENDING testcases in vault. Nothing to do.")
            return []

        print(f"Processing {len(rows)} testcase(s)...")
        results: List[PowerAnalysisResult] = []

        for row in rows:
            testcase_key = str(row["testcase_key"])
            asm_content = str(row["asm_content"])
            print(f"\n[{testcase_key}] ACE={row['ace_score']:.3f} RISK={row['risk_score']:.3f}")

            try:
                # 1. Compile
                print(f"  Compiling with {gcc}...")
                elf_path = _write_c_and_compile(asm_content, testcase_key, gcc)
                print(f"  ELF: {elf_path}")

                # 2. Run gem5 SE
                out_dir = materialized_root / testcase_key / "gem5_out"
                print(f"  Running gem5 SE...")
                gem5_stats = _run_gem5(elf_path, gem5_binary, gem5_config, out_dir)
                print(f"  gem5 exit={gem5_stats.get('returncode', -1)}, ticks={gem5_stats.get('sim_ticks', '?')}")

                # 3. Run McPAT
                mcpat_result = None
                mcpat_error = None
                print(f"  Running McPAT...")
                try:
                    mcpat_result = _run_mcpat(out_dir, mcpat_binary)
                    print(f"  McPAT power_total={mcpat_result['power_total']:.4f}W "
                          f"dynamic={mcpat_result['power_dynamic']:.4f}W")
                except Exception as exc:
                    mcpat_error = str(exc)
                    print(f"  McPAT error (non-fatal): {mcpat_error}")

                # 4. Update vault
                status = "COMPLETED" if mcpat_result else "GEM5_OK"
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    mcpat_power=mcpat_result["power_total"] if mcpat_result else None,
                    status=status,
                    metadata={"gem5_stats": gem5_stats, "mcpat_result": mcpat_result},
                )

                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path=str(elf_path),
                    gem5_out_dir=str(out_dir),
                    gem5_stats=gem5_stats,
                    mcpat_result=mcpat_result,
                    mcpat_error=mcpat_error,
                    status=status,
                ))
                print(f"  → {status}")

            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"  ✗ FAILED: {exc}")
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    status="FAILED",
                    metadata={"error": str(exc)},
                )
                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path="",
                    gem5_out_dir="",
                    gem5_stats={},
                    mcpat_result=None,
                    mcpat_error=str(exc),
                    status="FAILED",
                ))

        return results


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Power-analysis pipeline: vault → compile → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault"
    )
    p.add_argument("--db", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_VAULT, help="Vault SQLite path")
    p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10, help="Number of PENDING testcases to process")
    p.add_argument("--gem5-binary", type=Path, REDACTED)
    p.add_argument("--gem5-config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG)
    p.add_argument("--mcpat-binary", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY)
    p.add_argument("--gcc", default=None, help="aarch64-elf-gcc path (default: search PATH)")
    p.add_argument("--materialized-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT)
    return p


def main() -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    results = run_power_analysis(
        vault_path=args.db,
        limit=args.limit,
        gem5_binary=args.gem5_binary,
        gem5_config=args.gem5_config,
        mcpat_binary=args.mcpat_binary,
        gcc=args.gcc,
        materialized_root=args.materialized_root,
    )
    completed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status in ("COMPLETED", "GEM5_OK"))
    failed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "FAILED")
    print(f"\nDone: {completed} completed, {failed} failed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Power-analysis pipeline: vault → materialization → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault."""

    "/usr/local/bin/aarch64-elf-gcc",
    "aarch64-elf-gcc",
]

    for path in _AARCH64_GCC_CANDIDATES:
        if Path(path).is_file() or shutil.which(path):
            return path
    return "aarch64-elf-gcc"


def _escape_c_string(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


def _asm_block(lines) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'"{_escape_c_string(line)}\\n"' for line in lines if line.strip())

# to keep the file self-contained and avoid path issues).
def render_materialized_source(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str) -> str:
    asm_lines = [line.rstrip() for line in asm_content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not asm_lines:
        asm_lines = ["nop"]

    benchmark_body = [
        ".text", ".align 4",
        ".global sdc_benchmark_body", ".type sdc_benchmark_body, %function",
        "sdc_benchmark_body:",
        "adr x16, sdc_gprs",
    ]
    # Clear all GPRs
    for r in range(31):
        benchmark_body.append(f"mov x{r}, #0")
    # Clear SIMD
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"movi v{v}.16b, #0")
    benchmark_body.extend(asm_lines)
    # Capture final state
    for i in range(31):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str x{i}, [x16, #{i * 8}]")
    benchmark_body.extend([
        "adr x16, sdc_nzcv", "mrs x17, nzcv", "str x17, [x16]",
        "adr x16, sdc_simd",
    ])
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str q{v}, [x16, #{v * 16}]")
    benchmark_body.append("ret")

    return "\n".join([
        "#include <stdint.h>",
        "#include <stdio.h>",
        "#include <stdlib.h>",
        f"/* Materialized: {testcase_key} */",
        "static uint64_t sdc_gprs[31] = {0};",
        "static uint64_t sdc_nzcv = 0;",
        "static uint8_t sdc_simd[8 * 16] = {0};",
        "static uint8_t sdc_memory[256] = {0};",
        "",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_rotl64(uint64_t v, unsigned s){",
        "    return (v << s) | (v >> (64 - s));",

    """Write C source and compile to static ELF. Returns path to ELF."""
    source = render_materialized_source(asm_content, testcase_key)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sdc_mat_") as tmp:
        tmp_path = Path(tmp)
        src_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.c"
        elf_path = tmp_path / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        src_path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
        compile_cmd = [
            gcc,
            "-static",
            "-march=armv8-a",
            "-nostdlib",
            "-o", str(elf_path),
            str(src_path),
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(compile_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Compilation failed for {testcase_key}:\n{result.stderr}"
            )
        # Copy ELF to materialized root
        out_dir = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT / testcase_key
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest_elf = out_dir / f"{testcase_key}.elf"
        shutil.copy2(elf_path, dest_elf)
        return dest_elf


def _run_gem5(elf_path: Path, gem5_binary: Path, gem5_config: Path, out_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run gem5 SE on the ELF. Returns gem5 stats dict."""
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = [
        str(gem5_binary),
        "--outdir", str(out_dir),
        "-r", "0",
        str(gem5_config),
        "--elf", str(elf_path),
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = {"returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}

    stats_file = out_dir / "stats.txt"
    config_file = out_dir / "config.json"
    if stats_file.exists():
        stats["stats_file"] = str(stats_file)
        # Parse a few key stats
        for line in stats_file.read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.startswith("sim_ticks"):
                continue
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    stats["sim_ticks"] = int(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass

    if config_file.exists():
        stats["config_file"] = str(config_file)

    return stats


def _run_mcpat(target_dir: Path, mcpat_binary: Optional[Path]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run McPAT on gem5 output directory."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "mcpat"))
    from pypat.conversion.convert import run as run_mcpat_conversion
    result = run_mcpat_conversion(
        target_dir,
        template_profile="arm64-kunpeng920",
        print_level=1,
        mcpat_binary=mcpat_binary,
    )
    return {
        "power_total": float(result.get("power_total", 0.0)),
        "power_dynamic": float(result.get("power_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "power_leakage": float(result.get("power_leakage", 0.0)),
        "power_peak_dynamic": float(result.get("power_peak_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "mcpat_input": str(result.get("mcpat_input", "")),
        "mcpat_output": str(result.get("mcpat_output", "")),
        "stats_file": str(result.get("stats_file", "")),
        "config_file": str(result.get("config_file", "")),
    }


def _hash_key(asm_lines: List[str]) -> str:
    content = "\n".join(asm_lines)
    return hashlib.sha1(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class PowerAnalysisResult:
    testcase_key: str
    elf_path: str
    gem5_out_dir: str
    gem5_stats: Dict[str, Any]
    mcpat_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    mcpat_error: Optional[str]
    status: str  # COMPLETED or FAILED


def run_power_analysis(
    vault_path: Path,
    limit: int = 10,
    gem5_binary: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_BINARY,
    gem5_config: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG,
    mcpat_binary: Optional[Path] = None,
    gcc: str = None,
    materialized_root: Path = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT,
) -> List[PowerAnalysisResult]:
    """Run the full power-analysis pipeline on top-k vault entries."""
    if gcc is None:
        gcc = _find_aarch64_gcc()

    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))
    from sdc_vault import SDCVault, VaultEntry

    with SDCVault(vault_path) as vault:
        # Fetch PENDING entries sorted by risk score
        rows = vault.fetch_top_k_risky(limit, statuses=["PENDING"])
        if not rows:
            print("No PENDING testcases in vault. Nothing to do.")
            return []

        print(f"Processing {len(rows)} testcase(s)...")
        results: List[PowerAnalysisResult] = []

        for row in rows:
            testcase_key = str(row["testcase_key"])
            asm_content = str(row["asm_content"])
            print(f"\n[{testcase_key}] ACE={row['ace_score']:.3f} RISK={row['risk_score']:.3f}")

            try:
                # 1. Compile
                print(f"  Compiling with {gcc}...")
                elf_path = _write_c_and_compile(asm_content, testcase_key, gcc)
                print(f"  ELF: {elf_path}")

                # 2. Run gem5 SE
                out_dir = materialized_root / testcase_key / "gem5_out"
                print(f"  Running gem5 SE...")
                gem5_stats = _run_gem5(elf_path, gem5_binary, gem5_config, out_dir)
                print(f"  gem5 exit={gem5_stats.get('returncode', -1)}, ticks={gem5_stats.get('sim_ticks', '?')}")

                # 3. Run McPAT
                mcpat_result = None
                mcpat_error = None
                print(f"  Running McPAT...")
                try:
                    mcpat_result = _run_mcpat(out_dir, mcpat_binary)
                    print(f"  McPAT power_total={mcpat_result['power_total']:.4f}W "
                          f"dynamic={mcpat_result['power_dynamic']:.4f}W")
                except Exception as exc:
                    mcpat_error = str(exc)
                    print(f"  McPAT error (non-fatal): {mcpat_error}")

                # 4. Update vault
                status = "COMPLETED" if mcpat_result else "GEM5_OK"
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    mcpat_power=mcpat_result["power_total"] if mcpat_result else None,
                    status=status,
                    metadata={"gem5_stats": gem5_stats, "mcpat_result": mcpat_result},
                )

                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path=str(elf_path),
                    gem5_out_dir=str(out_dir),
                    gem5_stats=gem5_stats,
                    mcpat_result=mcpat_result,
                    mcpat_error=mcpat_error,
                    status=status,
                ))
                print(f"  → {status}")

            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"  ✗ FAILED: {exc}")
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    status="FAILED",
                    metadata={"error": str(exc)},
                )
                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path="",
                    gem5_out_dir="",
                    gem5_stats={},
                    mcpat_result=None,
                    mcpat_error=str(exc),
                    status="FAILED",
                ))

        return results


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Power-analysis pipeline: vault → compile → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault"
    )
    p.add_argument("--db", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_VAULT, help="Vault SQLite path")
    p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10, help="Number of PENDING testcases to process")
    p.add_argument("--gem5-binary", type=Path, REDACTED)
    p.add_argument("--gem5-config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG)
    p.add_argument("--mcpat-binary", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY)
    p.add_argument("--gcc", default=None, help="aarch64-elf-gcc path (default: search PATH)")
    p.add_argument("--materialized-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT)
    return p


def main() -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    results = run_power_analysis(
        vault_path=args.db,
        limit=args.limit,
        gem5_binary=args.gem5_binary,
        gem5_config=args.gem5_config,
        mcpat_binary=args.mcpat_binary,
        gcc=args.gcc,
        materialized_root=args.materialized_root,
    )
    completed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status in ("COMPLETED", "GEM5_OK"))
    failed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "FAILED")
    print(f"\nDone: {completed} completed, {failed} failed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

        str(gem5_config),
        "--elf", str(elf_path),
    ]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = {"returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}

    stats_file = out_dir / "stats.txt"
    config_file = out_dir / "config.json"
    if stats_file.exists():
        stats["stats_file"] = str(stats_file)
        # Parse a few key stats
        for line in stats_file.read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.startswith("sim_ticks"):
                continue
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    stats["sim_ticks"] = int(parts[1])
                except ValueError:
                    pass

    if config_file.exists():
        stats["config_file"] = str(config_file)

    return stats


def _run_mcpat(target_dir: Path, mcpat_binary: Optional[Path]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Run McPAT on gem5 output directory."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "mcpat"))
    from pypat.conversion.convert import run as run_mcpat_conversion
    result = run_mcpat_conversion(
        target_dir,
        template_profile="arm64-kunpeng920",
        print_level=1,
        mcpat_binary=mcpat_binary,
    )
    return {
        "power_total": float(result.get("power_total", 0.0)),
        "power_dynamic": float(result.get("power_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "power_leakage": float(result.get("power_leakage", 0.0)),
        "power_peak_dynamic": float(result.get("power_peak_dynamic", 0.0)),
        "mcpat_input": str(result.get("mcpat_input", "")),
        "mcpat_output": str(result.get("mcpat_output", "")),
        "stats_file": str(result.get("stats_file", "")),
        "config_file": str(result.get("config_file", "")),
    }


def _hash_key(asm_lines: List[str]) -> str:
    content = "\n".join(asm_lines)
    return hashlib.sha1(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class PowerAnalysisResult:
    testcase_key: str
    elf_path: str
    gem5_out_dir: str
    gem5_stats: Dict[str, Any]
    mcpat_result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    mcpat_error: Optional[str]
    status: str  # COMPLETED or FAILED


def run_power_analysis(
    vault_path: Path,
    limit: int = 10,
    gem5_binary: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_BINARY,
    gem5_config: Path = DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG,
    mcpat_binary: Optional[Path] = None,
    gcc: str = None,
    materialized_root: Path = DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT,
) -> List[PowerAnalysisResult]:
    """Run the full power-analysis pipeline on top-k vault entries."""
    if gcc is None:
        gcc = _find_aarch64_gcc()

    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))
    from sdc_vault import SDCVault, VaultEntry

    with SDCVault(vault_path) as vault:
        # Fetch PENDING entries sorted by risk score
        rows = vault.fetch_top_k_risky(limit, statuses=["PENDING"])
        if not rows:
            print("No PENDING testcases in vault. Nothing to do.")
            return []

        print(f"Processing {len(rows)} testcase(s)...")
        results: List[PowerAnalysisResult] = []

        for row in rows:
            testcase_key = str(row["testcase_key"])
            asm_content = str(row["asm_content"])
            print(f"\n[{testcase_key}] ACE={row['ace_score']:.3f} RISK={row['risk_score']:.3f}")

            try:
                # 1. Compile
                print(f"  Compiling with {gcc}...")
                elf_path = _write_c_and_compile(asm_content, testcase_key, gcc)
                print(f"  ELF: {elf_path}")

                # 2. Run gem5 SE
                out_dir = materialized_root / testcase_key / "gem5_out"
                print(f"  Running gem5 SE...")
                gem5_stats = _run_gem5(elf_path, gem5_binary, gem5_config, out_dir)
                print(f"  gem5 exit={gem5_stats.get('returncode', -1)}, ticks={gem5_stats.get('sim_ticks', '?')}")

                # 3. Run McPAT
                mcpat_result = None
                mcpat_error = None
                print(f"  Running McPAT...")
                try:
                    mcpat_result = _run_mcpat(out_dir, mcpat_binary)
                    print(f"  McPAT power_total={mcpat_result['power_total']:.4f}W "
                          f"dynamic={mcpat_result['power_dynamic']:.4f}W")
                except Exception as exc:
                    mcpat_error = str(exc)
                    print(f"  McPAT error (non-fatal): {mcpat_error}")

                # 4. Update vault
                status = "COMPLETED" if mcpat_result else "GEM5_OK"
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    mcpat_power=mcpat_result["power_total"] if mcpat_result else None,
                    status=status,
                    metadata={"gem5_stats": gem5_stats, "mcpat_result": mcpat_result},
                )

                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path=str(elf_path),
                    gem5_out_dir=str(out_dir),
                    gem5_stats=gem5_stats,
                    mcpat_result=mcpat_result,
                    mcpat_error=mcpat_error,
                    status=status,
                ))
                print(f"  → {status}")

            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"  ✗ FAILED: {exc}")
                vault.update_execution_result(
                    testcase_key,
                    status="FAILED",
                    metadata={"error": str(exc)},
                )
                results.append(PowerAnalysisResult(
                    testcase_key=testcase_key,
                    elf_path="",
                    gem5_out_dir="",
                    gem5_stats={},
                    mcpat_result=None,
                    mcpat_error=str(exc),
                    status="FAILED",
                ))

        return results


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Power-analysis pipeline: vault → compile → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault"
    )
    p.add_argument("--db", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_VAULT, help="Vault SQLite path")
    p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10, help="Number of PENDING testcases to process")
    p.add_argument("--gem5-binary", type=Path, REDACTED)
    p.add_argument("--gem5-config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG)
    p.add_argument("--mcpat-binary", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY)
    p.add_argument("--gcc", default=None, help="aarch64-elf-gcc path (default: search PATH)")
    p.add_argument("--materialized-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT)
    return p


def main() -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    results = run_power_analysis(
        vault_path=args.db,
        limit=args.limit,
        gem5_binary=args.gem5_binary,
        gem5_config=args.gem5_config,
        mcpat_binary=args.mcpat_binary,
        gcc=args.gcc,
        materialized_root=args.materialized_root,
    )
    completed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status in ("COMPLETED", "GEM5_OK"))
    failed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status == "FAILED")
    print(f"\nDone: {completed} completed, {failed} failed.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Copyright 2026

"""ARM64/Kunpeng920-like SE runner for SDC differential execution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import m5
from gem5.components.boards.simple_board import SimpleBoard
from gem5.components.cachehierarchies.classic.private_l1_private_l2_cache_hierarchy import (
    PrivateL1PrivateL2CacheHierarchy,
)
from gem5.components.memory import DualChannelDDR4_2400, SingleChannelDDR4_2400
from gem5.components.processors.cpu_types import (
    get_cpu_type_from_str,
    get_cpu_types_str_set,
)
from gem5.components.processors.simple_processor import SimpleProcessor
from gem5.isas import ISA
from gem5.resources.resource import BinaryResource
from gem5.simulate.simulator import Simulator

from sdc_fault_request import build_fault_request, write_fault_request


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Run an ARM64 static ELF in gem5 SE mode using a Kunpeng920-like "
            "cache/memory profile and record any requested fault metadata."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("binary", type=Path, help="Path to the ARM64 ELF to run.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--binary-arg",
        action="append",
        default=[],
        help="Argument passed to the guest binary. Repeat as needed.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cpu-type",
        choices=sorted(get_cpu_types_str_set()),
        default="o3",
        help="gem5 CPU model used for the SE run.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--clk-freq", default="2.6GHz", help="Board clock frequency.")
    parser.add_argument("--num-cores", type=int, default=1, help="Number of cores.")
    parser.add_argument("--l1i-size", default="64KiB", help="Private L1I size.")
    parser.add_argument("--l1d-size", default="64KiB", help="Private L1D size.")
    parser.add_argument("--l2-size", default="512KiB", help="Private L2 size.")
    parser.add_argument("--mem-size", default="4GiB", help="Total modeled memory size.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mem-channels",
        type=int,
        choices=[1, 2],
        default=2,
        help="Modeled memory-channel count supported by this lightweight script.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--stdout-file",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Guest stdout capture path. Defaults to <outdir>/guest.stdout.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--stderr-file",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Guest stderr capture path. Defaults to <outdir>/guest.stderr.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fault-model",
        default="none",
        help="Fault model name to record for downstream injection hooks.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fault-target",
        default="",
        help="Fault target identifier to record for downstream injection hooks.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fault-bit",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="Optional bit index for downstream injection hooks.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fault-tick",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="Optional tick at which the external injector should trigger.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-ticks",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="Optional maximum ticks passed to the simulator run.",
    )
    return parser


def _default_output_path(requested: Path | None, filename: str) -> Path:
    if requested is not None:
        return requested.resolve()
    return (Path(m5.options.outdir) / filename).resolve()


def _build_memory(mem_channels: int, mem_size: str):
    if mem_channels == 1:
        return SingleChannelDDR4_2400(mem_size)
    return DualChannelDDR4_2400(mem_size)


def _write_fault_manifest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Path:
    outdir = Path(m5.options.outdir).resolve()
    manifest_path = outdir / "sdc_fault_request.json"
    request = build_fault_request(
        fault_model=args.fault_model,
        fault_target=args.fault_target,
        fault_bit=args.fault_bit,
        fault_tick=args.fault_tick,
        binary=args.binary,
        binary_args=args.binary_arg,
        cpu_type=args.cpu_type,
        num_cores=args.num_cores,
        clk_freq=args.clk_freq,
    )
    return write_fault_request(request, manifest_path)


def main() -> None:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    outdir = Path(m5.options.outdir).resolve()
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    cache_hierarchy = PrivateL1PrivateL2CacheHierarchy(
        l1d_size=args.l1d_size,
        l1i_size=args.l1i_size,
        l2_size=args.l2_size,
    )
    processor = SimpleProcessor(
        cpu_type=get_cpu_type_from_str(args.cpu_type),
        isa=ISA.ARM,
        num_cores=args.num_cores,
    )
    board = SimpleBoard(
        clk_freq=args.clk_freq,
        processor=processor,
        memory=_build_memory(args.mem_channels, args.mem_size),
        cache_hierarchy=cache_hierarchy,
    )

    stdout_file = _default_output_path(args.stdout_file, "guest.stdout")
    stderr_file = _default_output_path(args.stderr_file, "guest.stderr")
    binary = BinaryResource(
        local_path=str(args.binary.resolve()),
        architecture=ISA.ARM,
    )
    board.set_se_binary_workload(
        binary,
        arguments=args.binary_arg,
        stdout_file=stdout_file,
        stderr_file=stderr_file,
    )

    fault_manifest = _write_fault_manifest(args)
    if args.fault_model != "none":
        print(
            "[sdc] fault metadata recorded at %s; "
            "an external injector must consume this request."
            % fault_manifest,
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

    simulator = Simulator(board=board)
    simulator.run(max_ticks=args.max_ticks)
    print(
        "Exiting @ tick {} because {}.".format(
            simulator.get_current_tick(), simulator.get_last_exit_event_cause()
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__m5_main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Power-analysis pipeline: vault → materialization → gem5 SE → McPAT → vault."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

# Repo root
REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DEFAULT_VAULT = REPO_ROOT / "artifacts" / "sdc_vault.sqlite3"
DEFAULT_GEM5_BINARY = REPO_ROOT / "gem5" / "build" / "ARM" / "gem5.opt"
DEFAULT_GEM5_CONFIG = (
    REPO_ROOT / "gem5" / "configs" / "example" / "arm" / "sdc_kunpeng920_se.py"
)
DEFAULT_MCPAT_BINARY = REPO_ROOT / "mcpat" / "mcpat" / "mcpat"
DEFAULT_MATERIALIZED_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "artifacts" / "materialized"
DIGEST_RE = re.compile(r"SDC_DIGEST=([0-9a-fA-F]+)")

# Path to the aarch64 bare-metal cross-compiler
_AARCH64_GCC_CANDIDATES = [
    "/opt/homebrew/bin/aarch64-elf-gcc",
    "/usr/local/bin/aarch64-elf-gcc",
    "aarch64-elf-gcc",
]


def _find_aarch64_gcc() -> str:
    for path in _AARCH64_GCC_CANDIDATES:
        if Path(path).is_file() or shutil.which(path):
            return path
    return "aarch64-elf-gcc"


def _escape_c_string(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


def _asm_block(lines) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'"{_escape_c_string(line)}\\n"' for line in lines if line.strip())


# Inline version of render_materialized_source (avoids import of sdc_materialize
# to keep the file self-contained and avoid path issues).
def render_materialized_source(asm_content: str, testcase_key: str) -> str:
    asm_lines = [line.rstrip() for line in asm_content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not asm_lines:
        asm_lines = ["nop"]

    benchmark_body = [
        ".text", ".align 4",

    for r in range(31):

    # Clear SIMD
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"movi v{v}.16b, #0")
    benchmark_body.extend(asm_lines)
    # Capture final state
    for i in range(31):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str x{i}, [x16, #{i * 8}]")
    benchmark_body.extend([
        "adr x16, sdc_nzcv", "mrs x17, nzcv", "str x17, [x16]",
        "adr x16, sdc_simd",
    ])
    for v in range(8):
        benchmark_body.append(f"str q{v}, [x16, #{v * 16}]")
    benchmark_body.append("ret")

    return "\n".join([
        "/* Materialized (bare-metal, no stdlib): " + testcase_key + " */",
        "typedef unsigned long      uint64_t;",
        "typedef unsigned int       uint32_t;",
        "typedef unsigned short     uint16_t;",
        "typedef unsigned char      uint8_t;",
        "typedef unsigned long     size_t;",
        "typedef long              int64_t;",
        "",
        "static uint64_t sdc_gprs[31] = {0};",
        "static uint64_t sdc_nzcv = 0;",
        "static uint8_t sdc_simd[8 * 16] = {0};",
        "static uint8_t sdc_memory[256] = {0};",
        "",
        "void printf_hex(uint64_t v) {",
        "    char buf[17];",
        "    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {",
        "        int nibble = (v >> ((15 - i) * 4)) & 0xF;",
        "        buf[i] = nibble < 10 ? ('0' + nibble) : ('a' + nibble - 10);",
        "    }",
        "    buf[16] = 0;",
        "    for (char *p = buf; *p; p++) {",
        "        volatile char *mmio = (volatile char *)(0x10000000 + (*p & 0xFF));",
        "        (void)*mmio;",
        "    }",
        "}",
        "",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_rotl64(uint64_t v, unsigned s){",
        "    return (v << s) | (v >> (64 - s));",
        "}",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_u64(uint64_t s, uint64_t v){",
        "    s ^= v + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (s << 6) + (s >> 2);",
        "    return sdc_rotl64(s, 17);",
        "}",
        "static inline uint64_t sdc_mix_bytes(uint64_t s,",
        "    const uint8_t *buf, size_t n){",
        "    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i){",
        "        s ^= (uint64_t)buf[i] << ((i & 7U) * 8U);",
        "        s *= 0x100000001b3ULL;",
        "        s = sdc_rotl64(s, 9);",
        "    }",

        "}",
        "extern void sdc_benchmark_body(void);",

        _asm_block(benchmark_body),

        "    d = sdc_mix_u64(d, sdc_nzcv);",
        "    d = sdc_mix_bytes(d, sdc_simd, sizeof(sdc_simd));",
